newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar, weaker vs pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar, weaker vs pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee was fixed firmer against the dollar but weaker versus the pound on Monday, forex dealers said.
The rupee rose to a mean commercial rate of 20.1385 for one dollar from 20.1910 last Friday. Against the pound, the rupee was quoted at a mean rate of 32.2295 from 32.1800 last Friday.
Forex dealers said the firmer rupee reflected a weaker currency in international markets.
They added that the central bank intervened in the interbank forex market last Friday by selling dollars to commercial banks which were running slightly short in their forex reserves.
"The slight shortage, which arose from importers' demand exceeding forex inflows, was also putting a slight depreciating pressure on the rupee," one dealer said.
